results.name: DRC Ebola 2026: Residential Areas 13
results.shortDescription:
In May 2026, an epidemic of Ebola was reported in the Ituri Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and only 5 months after the end of the previous outbreak. Imported cases from Ituri have been reported in the North Kivu Province, as well as in Uganda's capital city of Kampala.

The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which complicates response efforts as there are no proven vaccines and treatments. It was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) by the World Health Organization on 16 May 2026. There have been 247 confirmed deaths in DRC and two in Uganda as of the third week of June; however, it is likely that the true scale of the outbreak could considerably exceed the confirmed numbers (see wiki.org).

This mapping will support Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) in delivering supplies and identifying patient origins and hotspots (more info on the OSM Wiki Page for this Activation). The full priority area for this response can be seen and downloaded via this public uMap.

results.author: bluestarfish
